provider: Nostr relays + NIP-94/NIP-96 file metadata — index only, not bytes

free_tier.stated: Zero bytes. NIP-94 is a *metadata* event: `url`, `m` (mime), `size`, `dim`, `i` (torrent infohash), `thumb`. The relay stores the JSON pointer, the file lives elsewhere.

per_object_cap.stated: per-object-cap = relay event size limit (~64 KB

retention.stated: until the instance is recycled; not persistent

egress.terms: n/a — relay never serves the file.

tooling: nostr websocket protocol (EVENT/REQ), `nak` CLI. Relays are free and accept arbitrary events, but the event size limit (typ. 64 KB) caps any inline-base64 trick at ~48 KB.
chaining: Chains with Blossom: NIP-94/NIP-96 events make Blossom blobs discoverable and re-mirrorable. On its own this is not storage.

limits.value: per-object-cap = relay event size limit (~64 KB

reliability_note: Relays are ephemeral and freely delete events; free relays exist in the thousands but none is a byte store.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
